tasks.subject: Task 1: Register status, localization, and world setting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the documentation entry for `encumbered`, the localization key, and the world setting that gates the entire feature. After this task the setting is visible in Module Settings (default off) but has no behavioral effect.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/status-effects.mjs (append entry to STATUS_EFFECTS_REGISTRY)
- Modify: languages/en.json (add VCE.Status.Encumbered + VCE.Settings.HomebrewEncumbranceSpeed[Hint])
- Modify: scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs (register the setting in init hook, no onChange yet)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- game.settings.get returns false on fresh world
- Setting visible in Module Settings with correct name/hint
- game.i18n.localize('VCE.Status.Encumbered') returns 'Encumbered'
- No new console errors on world load

**Verify:** MCP evaluate snippet returns `{ setting: false, hasSettingDef: true, i18n: 'Encumbered' }`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/status-effects.mjs", "languages/en.json", "scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "MCP evaluate: see plan Task 1 Verify section", "acceptanceCriteria": ["setting registered default false", "settings dialog shows correct copy", "i18n key resolves", "no new console errors"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Install the prepareDerivedData speed patch (mechanical penalty)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Chain a second prepareDerivedData patch onto the existing focus-cap patch so when the homebrew setting is on, every PC's speed.base drops by 5 * (occupiedSlots - maxSlots) and crawl/travel cascade. Setting off → no-op.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs (extend the ready hook patch block; existing focus-cap patch is at lines ~466-491)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Setting OFF: speed.base matches RAW
- Setting ON, at slots=max: no change
- Setting ON, max+2: speed.base = max(0, originalBase - 10)
- Setting ON, max+100: speed.base = 0 (floored)
- speed.crawl and speed.travel cascade from the reduced base
- Toggle setting + actor.prepareData() flips the penalty live

**Verify:** MCP evaluate snippet creates a 99-slot junk item, asserts speed.base = 0 with setting on, restores RAW speed with setting off, cleans up.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "MCP evaluate: see plan Task 2 Verify section", "acceptanceCriteria": ["setting OFF leaves speed at RAW", "setting ON applies -5/over", "speed floors at 0", "crawl/travel cascade", "toggle is live"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Build EncumbranceManager + wire init/sweep/onChange
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the singleton that maintains the visual 'Encumbered' icon on every PC reactively (on inventory or fatigue changes), sweeps all PCs on world ready, and handles the setting-toggle case (re-derives speed + flips the icon globally).

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/encumbrance/encumbrance-manager.mjs (~100 lines)
- Modify: scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs (import + init + ready wiring + setting onChange)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Setting ON + over slots: actor has managed AE name='Encumbered', img='icons/svg/anchor.svg', statuses=['encumbered']
- Removing items so PC is no longer over: AE deleted within ~150ms
- Increasing fatigue (reduces maxSlots): flips fine PC to encumbered without inventory change
- Toggle OFF: AE cleared on all PCs, speed re-derived to RAW; toggle ON re-applies
- World ready: sweep runs, every existing PC's encumbered state correct
- GM-only writes (no duplicate creation across clients)

**Verify:** MCP evaluate snippet adds/removes inventory items + toggles setting, asserts AE creation/deletion and statuses set match expected.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/encumbrance/encumbrance-manager.mjs", "scripts/vagabond-character-enhancer.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "MCP evaluate: see plan Task 3 Verify section", "acceptanceCriteria": ["AE created when over slots", "AE deleted when under slots", "fatigue change flips state", "setting toggle sweeps all PCs", "GM-only writes"]}
```
